note: Declarative label taxonomy for LLM-Mailroom-Services/mailroom-issues — the cross-repo issue hub. Source of truth for scripts/labels.py sync/audit. Four orthogonal families route work: type/* (what the issue is), domain/* (which repo/platform it touches), priority/* (how urgent), status/* (where it is in the lifecycle). GitHub lifecycle labels (bug, enhancement, duplicate, invalid, wontfix, ...) follow their standard meanings. New labels are a manifest change, never a GitHub edit.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Improvements or additions to documentation

labels.name: question
labels.description: Further information is requested

labels.name: type/epic
labels.description: Cross-repo workstream: a program of work with child issues (one per repo/phase)

labels.name: type/rfc
labels.description: Design proposal for cross-repo review before implementation

labels.name: Digital Mailroom
labels.description: Issues, discussions, or tasks associated with the Monorepo.

labels.name: LLM Mailroom
labels.description: Core llm-mailroom repository/package related issue, task, or discussion.

labels.name: Mailroom ML
labels.description: mailroom-ml package (LLM-Mailroom-Services): ModernBERT train/infer/calibrate + intake-handoff contract.

labels.name: Mailroom Sandbox
labels.description: Local-Mailroom-Sandbox / Mailroom Sandbox related issue or task.

labels.name: Agents
